chunks: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj asked Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام
about the muhrim wearing khazz, so he said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abū al-Ḥasan, the Imam addressed in the report
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, the questioner in the narration
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a muhrim to wear khazz during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning clothing worn in the state of ihram. Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام states that there is no objection to the muhrim wearing khazz.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2621 - Abdul Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj asked Abu al-Hasan (as) about a Muhrim wearing khazz (a type of fabric).
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
